# Soapbox for Blygger 0.1.2 is on WordPress.org

*Released 2026-10-10 by Robert Peake, an independent client. [Soapbox for Blygger on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/soapbox-for-blygger/) · [source](https://github.com/cyberscribe/soapbox-blyg).*

Soapbox for Blygger makes a WordPress site a blyg. Every post you publish also becomes an item, with a permanent id that survives edits, renames and moves, a new version each time its visible content changes, and withdrawal when a post goes back to draft. It needs WordPress 6.6 and PHP 7.4.

It's the client the manifest-template construct was written for (§16.6e, decision #51). WordPress serves the item and pin documents from its REST API rather than at the default paths, so the manifest says where they are, with `item` and `pin` URL templates. robertpeake.com was where that construct was exercised: a Blygger Studio node subscribed, quoted an item, and the mention verified on the WordPress side (gate G9).

At WordPress.org's request the plugin is now named Soapbox for Blygger (slug `soapbox-for-blygger`). Nothing a reader sees has changed; the manifest's `generator` now reads `soapbox-for-blygger/<version>`.

Live at [robertpeake.com/blyg/](https://www.robertpeake.com/blyg/).



*Releases of independent clients are announced here by hand. To comment, respond to this item from your own blyg.*
